I only have read permissions for this folder.
You are discussing access to a workplace system, distinguishing a technical login from the permissions attached to an account. State your folder permission level.
Ik takes finite heb. Alleen limits the permissions to leesrechten, so the speaker can read this folder without claiming write access. Voor deze map names the folder; map is a de-word, so use deze.
Can you request access to the test environment?
You are discussing access to a workplace system, distinguishing a technical login from the permissions attached to an account. Ask a colleague to request access.

Kun precedes informal subject je in this request. Aanvragen stays joined as an infinitive without te. Toegang tot names the resource being requested; a testomgeving is a test environment, not production.
S=Een werkende aanmelding|V=geeft|NEG=niet automatisch|O=toegang tot alle mappen.
A working sign-in does not automatically give access to all folders.
You are discussing access to a workplace system, distinguishing a technical login from the permissions attached to an account. Distinguish signing in from folder permissions.

Een werkende aanmelding is a singular subject and takes geeft. Werkende has -e before the de-word aanmelding. Niet automatisch negates guaranteed access; tot alle mappen specifies the folders concerned.
Which permissions does this test account need?
You are discussing access to a workplace system, distinguishing a technical login from the permissions attached to an account. Ask which permissions this test account requires.

Welke rechten is the object question phrase; dit testaccount is the singular subject, so use heeft. Nodig is an adjective in iets nodig hebben, not a participle. Testaccount is a het-word, so use dit; plural rechten takes welke.
The administrator has granted temporary access.
You are discussing access to a workplace system, distinguishing a technical login from the permissions attached to an account. Report completed granting of temporary access.
Singular de beheerder takes heeft. Toegekend is the participle of separable toekennen: toe + ge + kend. Tijdelijke has -e before definite de toegang. The perfect reports that access has been granted.
S=De toegang|V=geldt|T=tot het einde van deze week.
Access is valid until the end of this week.
You are discussing access to a workplace system, distinguishing a technical login from the permissions attached to an account. Give the access expiry point.
De toegang is singular and takes geldt, meaning is valid. Tot het einde van deze week gives the end point. Deze agrees with the de-word week. No precise clock time within that final day is stated.
Tot het einde van deze week geldt de toegang.
Access is valid until the end of this week.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
We are not allowed to extend permissions without approval.
You are discussing access to a workplace system, distinguishing a technical login from the permissions attached to an account. Explain the approval condition for more permissions.

Plural we takes mogen; uitbreiden remains an infinitive without te. Niet zonder goedkeuring means that approval is required before extending the permissions. It does not say that extension is forbidden even with approval.
S=Ik|V=controleer|G=of de gebruiker de juiste rol heeft.
I check whether the user has the correct role.
You are discussing access to a workplace system, distinguishing a technical login from the permissions attached to an account. Describe a role check.

Ik takes finite controleer. Of introduces an embedded whether-question, with subject de gebruiker before final heeft. Juiste has -e before definite de rol. A check asks whether the role is correct; it does not assert that it is.
This request does not concern access to customer data.
You are discussing access to a workplace system, distinguishing a technical login from the permissions attached to an account. Limit the scope of the access request.

Deze aanvraag is singular and takes betreft. Geen negates access to customer data as the scope of the request. Toegang tot identifies what could be accessed; the sentence does not deny that the request concerns something else.
Can you mention the expiry date in the ticket?
You are discussing access to a workplace system, distinguishing a technical login from the permissions attached to an account. Request a recorded expiry date.

Kun precedes informal je. Vermelden is an infinitive without te after kunnen. De vervaldatum is the information to include, and in het ticket gives its recorded location. Vermelden has inseparable ver-.
May I change this setting in the test environment?
You are seeking explicit permission for a workplace change, making the proposed action and its scope clear. Request permission for one test-setting change.
Mag starts this permission question before subject ik. Wijzigen is an infinitive without te. Deze matches the de-word instelling; in de testomgeving limits where the proposed change would happen.
We do not yet have permission for production.
You are seeking explicit permission for a workplace change, making the proposed action and its scope clear. State that production is outside current permission.

We takes plural hebben as a main verb of possession here, not a perfect auxiliary. Nog geen toestemming means not yet having permission. Voor productie identifies the production environment covered by that missing approval.
Voor productie hebben we nog geen toestemming.
We do not yet have permission for production.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
I want to explain the consequences first.
You are seeking explicit permission for a workplace change, making the proposed action and its scope clear. Offer an explanation before consent.

Ik takes wil, expressing a wish or intention rather than the English future will. Toelichten remains joined as an infinitive without te. Eerst says that explaining the consequences should happen before the next action.
Who is allowed to approve this change?
You are seeking explicit permission for a workplace change, making the proposed action and its scope clear. Ask who holds approval authority.

Wie is itself the subject of the question and takes ordinary singular mag in this unspecified inquiry. Goedkeuren stays an infinitive without te after mogen. Deze wijziging is the object; this asks who has permission to approve it.
Your permission applies only to this single check.
You are seeking explicit permission for a workplace change, making the proposed action and its scope clear. Limit a formally addressed user's permission to one check.

The singular subject is uw toestemming, so use geldt even though uw addresses the listener. Alleen voor deze ene controle restricts the permission to this single check. Voor names its scope, not a deadline.
S=Ik|V=wacht|G=tot de eigenaar schriftelijk akkoord geeft.
I wait until the owner gives written agreement.
You are seeking explicit permission for a workplace change, making the proposed action and its scope clear. State the approval prerequisite.

Ik takes finite wacht; tot introduces the condition ending the wait. In that subordinate clause, de eigenaar precedes final geeft. Schriftelijk describes giving approval in writing, rather than merely discussing it orally.
An oral proposal is not approval yet.
You are seeking explicit permission for a workplace change, making the proposed action and its scope clear. Distinguish a spoken suggestion from approval.

Een mondeling voorstel is a singular subject and takes is. Voorstel is a het-word; after indefinite een, mondeling has no -e. Nog geen goedkeuring is a noun complement, not an object of is. A spoken proposal does not itself constitute approval.
May we start the planned interruption now?
You are seeking explicit permission for a workplace change, making the proposed action and its scope clear. Ask for permission at the execution moment.

Mogen precedes plural subject we in this permission question. Starten stays an infinitive without te. Geplande has -e before definite de onderbreking. Nu asks about beginning at the current moment, not just planning it.
The user has only permitted screen viewing.
You are seeking explicit permission for a workplace change, making the proposed action and its scope clear. Clarify that control was not granted.

Singular de gebruiker takes heeft. Toegestaan is the participle of separable toestaan. Alleen de schermweergave restricts the permitted action to viewing the screen in this scenario; remote control has not been granted.
G=Zonder dat de eigenaar akkoord is,|V=voeren|S=we|O=niets|PART=uit.
Without the owner's agreement, we carry out nothing.
You are seeking explicit permission for a workplace change, making the proposed action and its scope clear. Make execution dependent on approval.

The whole zonder dat-clause comes first, followed by main finite voeren and subject we. Its is is final after de eigenaar akkoord. Uitvoeren splits into voeren ... uit. Niets is the negative object: nothing is carried out without agreement.
We use only test data for this check.
You are preparing a controlled workplace test with a colleague, keeping test data and the live system separate. Specify the data used for the check.

We takes plural gebruiken. Voor deze controle gives the purpose, not a time. Uitsluitend means only and restricts the object to testgegevens, a plural noun. Using test data here does not claim that the test has already succeeded.
I have described the expected results in advance.
You are preparing a controlled workplace test with a colleague, keeping test data and the live system separate. Report documented expected outcomes.

Ik takes perfect auxiliary heb. Beschreven is the irregular participle of inseparable beschrijven, without extra ge-. Verwachte has -e before plural resultaten. Vooraf means in advance of performing the test.
We must record the initial state first.
You are preparing a controlled workplace test with a colleague, keeping test data and the live system separate. Set the first preparation step.

We takes plural moeten. Vastleggen remains a joined infinitive without te after moeten. De beginsituatie is the initial state to record, and eerst places that task before later work. Vastleggen is separable when finite: we leggen de beginsituatie vast.
Eerst moeten we de beginsituatie vastleggen.
We must record the initial state first.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
Which functions fall within this test?
You are preparing a controlled workplace test with a colleague, keeping test data and the live system separate. Clarify the test scope.
Welke functies is itself the plural subject, so finite vallen follows it without another subject. Binnen deze test describes the test scope, not a physical container. Deze agrees with de test.
The production system is not part of this trial.
You are preparing a controlled workplace test with a colleague, keeping test data and the live system separate. Exclude production from the trial.
Singular het productiesysteem takes hoort. Horen bij means be part of or belong to here, rather than hear a sound. Niet negates membership in this trial. Proef is a de-word, so use deze.
IM=Maak|O=een kopie van de huidige configuratie.
Make a copy of the current configuration.
You are preparing a controlled workplace test with a colleague, keeping test data and the live system separate. Ask for a configuration backup.

Maak is the imperative stem of maken, with the addressed person understood. Een kopie is the object; van de huidige configuratie identifies what is copied. Huidige has -e before the definite de-word configuratie.
I check whether the test account is ready.
You are preparing a controlled workplace test with a colleague, keeping test data and the live system separate. Describe a readiness check.

Ik takes controleer. Of introduces an embedded whether-question with singular subject het testaccount before final klaarstaat. Klaarstaan is separable in a main clause, but its finite form remains joined at the end of this subordinate clause.
The test list also includes the expected error messages.
You are preparing a controlled workplace test with a colleague, keeping test data and the live system separate. Include expected error cases.

De testlijst is singular and takes bevat. Ook adds expected error messages to the list alongside its other contents. Verwachte has -e before plural foutmeldingen. Listing an expected message is different from observing it during a test.
Can you go through the preconditions with me?
You are preparing a controlled workplace test with a colleague, keeping test data and the live system separate. Request a joint precondition review.

Kun precedes informal subject je; nalopen stays joined as an infinitive without te. De randvoorwaarden are the preconditions to check, and met mij makes it a joint review with the speaker. Mij is an object form after met.
Before we begin, we confirm the stopping criteria.
You are preparing a controlled workplace test with a colleague, keeping test data and the live system separate. Establish stop criteria before execution.

The complete voordat-clause is first; main finite bevestigen follows it before subject we. Within the before-clause, we precedes final beginnen. Stopcriteria is the plural of het stopcriterium and names the conditions for stopping.
You are reporting a workplace test observation, separating the observed outcome from approval or a claim of complete success. Report a matching result.

Het resultaat is singular and takes komt. Overeenkomen met means match or correspond to; the finite verb splits into komt ... overeen around met onze verwachting. Onze agrees with the de-word verwachting.
The second step does not give the expected result.
You are reporting a workplace test observation, separating the observed outcome from approval or a claim of complete success. Report an unexpected second-step result.

De tweede stap is a singular subject and takes geeft. Niet negates het verwachte resultaat, a definite object, so it is not replaced by geen. Verwachte has -e after definite het even though resultaat is a het-word.
We have seen the same error again.
You are reporting a workplace test observation, separating the observed outcome from approval or a claim of complete success. Report a repeated observation.

We takes plural perfect auxiliary hebben. Gezien is the irregular participle of zien. Dezelfde agrees with the de-word fout; opnieuw means again. The sentence reports recurrence, not an explanation of the cause.
Which value differs from the initial state?
You are reporting a workplace test observation, separating the observed outcome from approval or a claim of complete success. Ask what changed from the baseline.

Welke waarde is the singular question subject and takes verschilt. Verschillen van names what the value is compared with. Van de beginsituatie means compared with the recorded initial state in this scenario.
The test succeeds with the small file.
You are reporting a workplace test observation, separating the observed outcome from approval or a claim of complete success. Limit success to the small-file condition.

De test is singular and takes slaagt. Slagen means succeed or pass here. Met het kleine bestand limits the observed success to the small-file condition. Kleine has -e after definite het; this does not establish success with every file.
External access has not been tested.
You are reporting a workplace test observation, separating the observed outcome from approval or a claim of complete success. State an untested scope.

De externe toegang is singular and takes is. Is getest is a completed passive, with getest the participle of testen; niet negates whether testing happened. Externe has -e before definite de toegang. Untested is different from tested and failed.
I have recorded the deviation with a screenshot.
You are reporting a workplace test observation, separating the observed outcome from approval or a claim of complete success. Report evidence of the deviation.

Ik takes perfect auxiliary heb. Vastgelegd is the participle of separable vastleggen. Met een schermafbeelding identifies the evidence used to record the deviation. The sentence reports documentation, not a confirmed diagnosis.
S=Het laden|V=duurt|T=langer|PP=dan in de vorige versie.
Loading takes longer than in the previous version.
You are reporting a workplace test observation, separating the observed outcome from approval or a claim of complete success. Compare load time with the previous version.

Het laden is an infinitive used as an activity noun and takes singular duurt. Langer is the comparative of lang; dan introduces the comparison with loading in the previous version. Vorige has -e before de versie.
We do not yet know why this step fails.
You are reporting a workplace test observation, separating the observed outcome from approval or a claim of complete success. Separate failed observation from diagnosis.

We takes plural weten. Waarom introduces an embedded why-question, not a conjunction giving the reason. Singular deze stap precedes final mislukt. Nog niet means that the cause is not yet known, even though the failure has been observed.
The results must be assessed first.
You are reporting a workplace test observation, separating the observed outcome from approval or a claim of complete success. State the review needed before decisions.

Plural de resultaten takes moeten. Worden is a bare infinitive after the modal, and beoordeeld is its passive participle, not another infinitive. Eerst places assessment before the next decision; beoordeeld worden is also a possible final passive-group order.
We schedule the change outside the busiest hours.
You are arranging when a workplace change may happen, considering users, interruption windows and communication. Avoid peak hours when scheduling.

We takes plural plannen. Buiten de drukste uren places the scheduled change outside peak hours. Drukste is the superlative of druk, used with -e before plural uren. Planning is distinct from carrying out the change.
Buiten de drukste uren plannen we de wijziging.
We schedule the change outside the busiest hours.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
Which time window suits the teams involved?
You are arranging when a workplace change may happen, considering users, interruption windows and communication. Ask for a suitable window in a Belgian workplace context.

Welk tijdvenster is the singular question subject and takes past. Tijdvenster is a het-word, so use welk. Passen voor someone is used in Belgian scheduling contexts; voor de betrokken teams names the people whose schedules must fit, not a deadline.
The user must know in advance when the interruption starts.
You are arranging when a workplace change may happen, considering users, interruption windows and communication. State the advance communication need.

De gebruiker is singular and takes moet. Weten is an infinitive without te; the following wanneer-clause gives what must be known. In it, singular de onderbreking precedes final begint. Vooraf means in advance.
The change is not yet definitively scheduled.
You are arranging when a workplace change may happen, considering users, interruption windows and communication. Clarify the provisional date.

De wijziging is singular and takes staat. Ingepland is the participle of separable inplannen used with staan to describe its scheduled state. Nog niet definitief means that scheduling is not final yet, without saying there is no provisional plan.
Can we move execution to Wednesday evening?
You are arranging when a workplace change may happen, considering users, interruption windows and communication. Propose another execution window.

Kunnen precedes plural subject we; verplaatsen stays an infinitive without te. Naar woensdagavond gives the proposed new time. Verplaatsen means reschedule here and does not by itself say whether Wednesday is earlier or later.
I have informed the colleagues involved about the time.
You are arranging when a workplace change may happen, considering users, interruption windows and communication. Report advance notification.

Ik takes perfect auxiliary heb. Geïnformeerd is the participle of informeren; the diaeresis separates the vowels in ge- and informeerd. De betrokken collega's is the object, and over het tijdstip names the information given.
Over het tijdstip heb ik de betrokken collega's geïnformeerd.
I have informed the colleagues involved about the time.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
The maintenance window ends at eight o'clock.
You are arranging when a workplace change may happen, considering users, interruption windows and communication. State the window's end time.

Singular het onderhoudsvenster takes eindigt. Om acht uur names the clock time, with singular uur after the number in this time expression. The sentence states the end time without identifying morning or evening.
Om acht uur eindigt het onderhoudsvenster.
The maintenance window ends at eight o'clock.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
G=Als het werk uitloopt,|V=stoppen|S=we|T=op het afgesproken moment.
If the work overruns, we stop at the agreed time.
You are arranging when a workplace change may happen, considering users, interruption windows and communication. State the agreed stopping point despite overrun.

The entire als-clause comes first, then main finite stoppen and subject we. In the if-clause, singular het werk precedes joined uitloopt from separable uitlopen. Op het afgesproken moment states the agreed stopping time even if work is unfinished.
We must also allow time for the post-change check.
You are arranging when a workplace change may happen, considering users, interruption windows and communication. Include checking within the scheduled time.

We takes plural moeten; voorzien stays an infinitive without te. Ook means also, not a time. Tijd voor de nacontrole names time allocated for the later check. Voorzien in this Belgian workplace use means allow or provide for.
Who is available during the change?
You are arranging when a workplace change may happen, considering users, interruption windows and communication. Ask who can be contacted during execution.

Wie is the subject and takes ordinary singular is in this inquiry. Tijdens de wijziging names the interval. Bereikbaar means reachable or contactable here, rather than merely free from other work. The predicate adjective has no -e.
The change is awaiting formal approval.
You are reviewing a proposed change and its rollback plan, keeping approval, execution and successful verification separate. State the approval status.

Singular de wijziging takes wacht. Wachten op names what is awaited; the change itself is figuratively pending approval. Formele has -e before the de-word goedkeuring. The sentence reports pending approval, not completed execution.
We must have a recovery plan before we begin.
You are reviewing a proposed change and its rollback plan, keeping approval, execution and successful verification separate. Set a recovery-plan prerequisite.

We takes plural moeten; hebben is an infinitive without te and means possess a plan. Voordat introduces a full subordinate before-clause, with subject we before final beginnen. It is not just a noun time phrase.
When do we roll back the change?
You are reviewing a proposed change and its rollback plan, keeping approval, execution and successful verification separate. Ask for the rollback decision point.
Wanneer asks for the decision time or condition. Finite draaien precedes subject we, and terug is the separated particle of terugdraaien. De wijziging is the object to be rolled back.
The owner has approved only the test.
You are reviewing a proposed change and its rollback plan, keeping approval, execution and successful verification separate. Limit approval to testing.
Singular de eigenaar takes heeft. Goedgekeurd is the participle of separable goedkeuren. Alleen de test restricts what was approved; it does not establish approval for the live change.
S=Een geslaagde installatie|V=is|C=nog geen geslaagde nacontrole.
A successful installation is not a successful post-change check yet.
You are reviewing a proposed change and its rollback plan, keeping approval, execution and successful verification separate. Distinguish installation from verified behaviour.

Een geslaagde installatie is singular and takes is. Nog geen geslaagde nacontrole is a noun complement, not an object. Both installatie and nacontrole are de-words, so geslaagde has -e. Installation success does not itself verify the resulting behaviour.
G=Als de controle mislukt,|V=herstellen|S=we|O=de vorige instelling.
If the check fails, we restore the previous setting.
You are reviewing a proposed change and its rollback plan, keeping approval, execution and successful verification separate. State the agreed recovery action.

The entire als-clause is first, then main finite herstellen and subject we. Inside the if-clause, de controle precedes final mislukt. De vorige instelling is the object restored if that condition occurs, not a claim that recovery has already happened.
I document the reason for rolling back.
You are reviewing a proposed change and its rollback plan, keeping approval, execution and successful verification separate. Describe documenting the rollback decision.

Vastleggen splits into finite leg and final particle vast. The object de reden voor het terugdraaien stands between them. Het terugdraaien is a nominalised infinitive after voor; it names the rollback activity.
Can you go through the recovery steps in advance?
You are reviewing a proposed change and its rollback plan, keeping approval, execution and successful verification separate. Request advance recovery-plan review.

Kun precedes informal je; nalopen is an infinitive without te. De herstelstappen is the object and vooraf means in advance. The request concerns reviewing the steps, not claiming that recovery has already been performed.
We have kept the old configuration.
You are reviewing a proposed change and its rollback plan, keeping approval, execution and successful verification separate. Report preservation of the previous configuration.

We takes plural perfect auxiliary hebben. Bewaard is the participle of inseparable bewaren without extra ge-. Oude has -e before definite de configuratie. Keeping the old configuration is distinct from restoring it.
The administrator decides whether we may proceed.
You are reviewing a proposed change and its rollback plan, keeping approval, execution and successful verification separate. Identify the proceed authority.

De beheerder is singular and takes beslist. Of introduces an embedded whether-question with subject we before final mogen doorgaan. Mogen expresses permission; doorgaan remains a joined infinitive without te.
